reply_text:
Vantorre Group changed hands from you on **Monday, 4 May 2026**.

Moss's Sunday prep for Ruth, dated 3 May, says "Vantorre Group changes hands tomorrow, 2026-05-04." Moss's 4 May digest confirms it. It says your old industrial account was reassigned in the CRM effective that day, and that Mateo Quiroga was told about the contact change at 08:30.

The 4 May digest also says Gideon Sato took over Vantorre Mobility, the subsidiary, that same day.

Source: teams/team-strategic/digests/2026-05-03-strategic-sunday.md and teams/team-strategic/digests/2026-05-04-strategic-digest.md
